verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection-management platform. A platform like this could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a user's data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Smithery itself producing insights or suggestions from user data: the docs cover OAuth and connection proxying, publishing, triggers, namespaces and CLI tool calls, and the hosted services shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
